g.text: 6. PSQL - tables and the functions that touch them
status : open | closed | analysed | analyse_failed = open
unique index: one open session per user_id
A row exists only after the reporter accepts PDPA.
insert_user: INSERT, on conflict returns the same row.
open - open_session (INSERT, or the existing open session)
closed - close_session (still open and silent > N minutes)
analyse_failed - allowed by the CHECK, set by no function
- set to now() by every open_session
location, sticker - allowed by the CHECK, inserted by no function
ties the image to a report
ok - communicator, and analyser when the answer parses
error - analyser when the answer does not parse
stream_cut - allowed by the CHECK, set by no function
insert_ai_config runs once on a fresh database:
2 models + 2 prompts + 1 ai_configs in one transaction.
